query:
SELECT ua.id, ua.actionType, ua.description, ua.dxfUrl, ua.imageUrl, ua.segmentCount, ua.feature, ua.createdAt
FROM user_actions ua
JOIN app_users u ON ua.appUserId = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'liad118811@gmail.com'
ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
